complete_examples.text: One part is the stiffness of the track superstructures (rail, rail pads and sleepers), termed as the rail bending stiffness and the rail pad stiffness which are relatively easy to be controlled.
The result in Ref. [64] further indicated that the wheel load distribution factor was affected by the rail pad stiffness and the sleeper spacing.
